mLocKeys.keySummary: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, <status>Slowing</status> enemies hit by @SlowPercent*100@% and dealing <magicDamage>@ScatterDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The stones detonate when enemies dash or are <status>Knocked</status> through them, <status>Stunning</status> for the remaining movement duration + @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@DetonationDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The stun's duration cannot exceed @MaxStunDuration@ seconds. Each enemy can only be stunned once per cast. Monsters are always stunned for the maximum duration.
Stones beyond the first one deal @MineDamageFalloff*100@% less damage.
Max detonation damage: @MaxDetonationDamageTooltip@
This ability deals @MonsterModPercent*100@% damage to monsters.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit is stunned after tripping over a rock.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rock Surfing</titleLeft><mainText>Taliyah gains <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f1@%</font> Move Speed by running near walls. Only occurs out of combat.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Taliyah gains <speed>@TotalMS@ Move Speed</speed> while out of combat if she has been near a wall within the last @FallOffTime@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing @RockDamage@ magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal @ExtraMissileReducedDamagePercent@% less damage.

Casts on worked ground cost @Effect7Amount@ Mana and have @WorkedGroundCDR*100@% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds, dealing @BigRockDamage@ magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for @MonsterStunDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Taliyah can move and use other Abilities while hurling rocks.
Casting this Ability on Worked Ground cannot reduce its Cooldown to less than @MinimumWorkedGroundCD@ seconds.
Total damage to a single target: @MaxDamageTooltip@
Each rock deals @TotalBonusFlatMonsterDamage@ additional damage to monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for @Effect1Amount@ seconds. If she immediately Recasts, she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride.

This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last @DamageLockoutTime@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Once the wall is fully formed, Taliyah can <recast>Recast</recast> to destroy it early.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription:
Weaver's Wall (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownCast once to create a wall. Recast immediately to ride ahead of the wall. Moving or receiving damage will cause Taliyah to stop.

Weaver's Wall lasts for @Effect1Amount@ seconds. Deactivate this spell to break the wall early.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Taliyah quakes the earth, <status>Knocking</status> enemies in an area in the chosen direction.
